stem: Find the general term of the sequence $\{a_n\}$ determined by the following conditions. $a_1={=c}, \ a_{n+1}={=r}a_n$
solution: The relation $a_{n+1}={=r}a_n$ means each term is {=r} times the previous one, so the sequence is geometric with first term {=c} and common ratio {=r}.
notes: Geometric recurrence with first term not 1 and possibly negative ratio. Same skeleton as book 3-g.
